intent: Show clean components beside a connector whose authority shrinks to one cluster. The smaller scope indicator makes least-privilege change concrete without exposing credential values.
source:
**Location:** `hugging-face-infrastructure`

**Frame:** Core infrastructure is wiped and rebuilt from clean components. A service connector sheds a broad credential and receives a cluster-scoped one.

**Font:** `narration`

**Caption:**
> CORE SYSTEMS REBUILT. CONNECTOR AUTHORITY NARROWED.

**Provenance:** `documented` + visual `compressed`.
title: Clean rebuilding accompanies narrower connector scope
